article.opening: After moving through {{priorSign}} from {{priorSignEntryDate}} to {{priorSignExitDate}}, Mars enters Gemini on {{entryDate}}, and the next move comes through a quick question or a change of plan. A stuck exchange gets a new angle. An unfamiliar skill becomes worth learning. Better information changes what happens next.
article.tension: That flexibility helps until every possibility feels equally urgent. We follow three ideas, start two tasks, and change direction before either is finished. A disagreement that could clarify the issue becomes a contest for the quickest answer. The sharper the comeback, the farther the conversation moves from what needed to be decided. Energy stays high, but it is split among arguments, new starts, and loose ends.
